atoms.a: Al’s Shoes World has lots of sales for the end of the season. Trainers, for example, are now 50% off. Brown leather shoes are 25% off. Which pair of shoes has the bigger sale?

The school’s cross-country team is running a race. Bernie, who is wearing a blue top, has already run <mat>2/3</mat> of the distance. Alex, who is wearing a yellow top, has made it 70% of the distance. Who has run a larger distance?

The school’s vending machine offers different kinds of soft drinks. Mark wants to know how much sugar each soft drink contains and checks the label on the back. The red can contains 10% sugar, the yellow can 8% and the blue can 11.2%. Which can contains the least amount of sugar?
